source_snapshot.scope: Scoped current-main path and source census. Candidate PR branches are recorded separately and are not treated as merged or qualified.
source_snapshot.duplicate_workspace_note: The repository contains top-level and mycelix-workspace copies of several projects. Inspected support-ticket and civic files in those copies had identical blob SHAs; this census does not infer which copy is the future canonical build root.

candidates.scope_limit: Generic Mycelix support tickets; not a Johannesburg Water or City CRM record.
candidates.finding: Fields include title, description, generic category/priority/status, requester, optional assignee and timestamps; no municipal source reference, utility work-order identity, or independently verified physical-repair state.

candidates.semantic_concern: Mycelix-internal ticket creation, update and close operations
candidates.finding: Creates/updates entries, links requester/status/category, emits an internal bridge signal and exposes close_ticket; closing a ticket is not evidence of physical service restoration.

candidates.scope_limit: General support domain vocabulary; not a municipal service taxonomy or SLA registry.
candidates.finding: TicketStatus and TicketPriority exist, but do not define utility-specific response clocks, field dispatch states or source-system currentness.

candidates.semantic_concern: Shared justice/media evidence and custody concepts
candidates.scope_limit: General evidence types; not a Johannesburg municipal repair-verification implementation.
candidates.finding: Evidence and custody structures exist, but an attested evidence record is not by itself proof that a repair occurred or that service was restored.

candidates.scope_limit: Formal dispute procedure, not routine municipal service request intake or work-order tracking.
candidates.finding: Case phases/statuses represent disputes, mediation/arbitration and enforcement; repurposing these would conflate service operations and adjudication.

candidates.semantic_concern: Cross-domain dispatch and event/query transport inside Commons
candidates.scope_limit: Internal Mycelix cluster bridge; no Johannesburg provider/API adapter established.
candidates.finding: The bridge routes among Commons domains and broadcasts internal events; this does not establish external City API access, acceptance semantics, authentication, currentness or idempotent provider submission.

candidates.scope_limit: Displays Mycelix community water-system capacity/fill/steward data; not municipal resident intake.
candidates.finding: A display page is not proof of an operational case intake, utility fault-routing or repair-closure workflow.

candidates.semantic_concern: Water harvesting, storage and stewardship domain
candidates.scope_limit: Resource/capture records, not municipal fault/request lifecycle.
candidates.finding: Models harvesting systems, tanks and capture/recharge records; it is not a utility pipe-break repair queue.

candidates.scope_limit: Product/BOM/routing work orders; not municipal service requests.
candidates.finding: Has manufacturing-specific work order/status transition types. Its presence does not justify reusing it as a municipal ticket owner.

candidates.semantic_concern: Stable municipal service-issue identity and end-to-end operational state
candidates.scope_limit: No suitable authoritative municipal service-issue runtime identified in the scoped current-main census.
candidates.finding: Do not infer global absence from scoped search; current main did not expose an approved municipal runtime or adapter. Existing generic ActionHash/revision identity is not a municipal logical identity contract.

candidates.semantic_concern: Authorised City/utility source-system adapter and currentness mapping
candidates.scope_limit: No provider contract, API access grant or City integration established.
candidates.finding: City/utility reference numbers must remain external references; successful local persistence or submission must not be interpreted as municipal acceptance or current status.

candidates.semantic_concern: Versioned municipal service-level definitions and SLA clocks
candidates.scope_limit: No current approved Joburg-specific SLA registry found in the inspected current-main implementation.
candidates.finding: The City document index lists 2026/27 planning documents and a 2025/26 service-standards charter. The charter is a reference baseline only until the current adopted target, clock semantics and effective dates are verified.

candidates.semantic_concern: Municipal completion-claim, evidence and independent verification adapter
candidates.scope_limit: No municipal repair-closure verification implementation identified in the inspected current-main surfaces.
candidates.finding: Ticket status, an official-looking receipt, a contractor claim and a verified physical outcome are distinct artifacts.

candidates.semantic_concern: Administrative procedure for rights-affecting government decisions
candidates.scope_limit: No exact ADMIN-001/002/003 path identified by the scoped current-main census; broader absence is not asserted.
candidates.finding: Routine service resolution must not become an AI-made benefits, entitlement, billing-dispute, disconnection or licensing decision.

candidates.semantic_concern: External source submission, retry and offline/idempotency contract
candidates.scope_limit: No City provider adapter or external idempotency contract identified.
candidates.finding: A retry after a timeout must not silently create duplicate City requests; do not promise at-most-once or exactly-once behavior without provider semantics and tests.

owner_matrix.decision: Block implementation. Current-main generic ticket ActionHash/revision identity does not establish the stable municipal issue identity; SUP-CIV-001A is an open branch-only proposal.
Useful internal create/update history exists, but there is no verified linkage to a City/utility-originated intake record or source currentness.
The internal status enum is only local Mycelix state; external currentness remains unimplemented and must be sourced from an authorised provider.
An optional internal assignee exists; a municipal team/vehicle/spares/dispatch contract was not identified. Keep Symthaea output advisory.
Existing water UI is a resource dashboard, not evidence of resident fault intake or accessible multi-channel municipal reporting.
Reuse evidence concepts only after the adapter defines protected storage/reference policy; evidence creation does not imply verification.
Do not implement or automate consequential resident decisions until the legitimate procedure/authority owner is identified and bound.
Preserve the City/utility reference as a typed external source reference; do not mint it locally or treat a mirror as current.
Keep commitment, completion claim, evidence bundle, predicate verification and downstream outcome as distinct artifacts.
No SLA math until official target source/version, clock start/stop, pauses/exclusions, denominator and reopen treatment are explicit.
No live provider retry path without a qualified idempotency key, timeout reconciliation, duplicate-submission behavior and stale/offline rules.
Water capture/stewardship models are not municipal repair operations.
Manufacturing work orders must not be promoted into a public-works owner based on structural similarity.
Keep routine service tickets distinct from legal or quasi-judicial cases.
Internal cross-domain event/query routing is not proof of an authorised external municipal integration.
Symthaea may propose grouping, urgency and routing only; it must not create municipal authority or trigger state-changing actions.

branch_only_proposals.scope_note: Composition boundary is a documentation/manifest/validator proposal; not merged authority.
Johannesburg threat/privacy profile template; real-world processing disabled.
Completion evidence/verification/outcome separation contract; no qualification inheritance.
Stable support-ticket identity proposal; not part of main at the census snapshot.
Typed ticket mutation contract stacked on SUP-CIV-001A; inherits no qualification until its own gates pass.
Adversarial municipal procurement fixture, not a service-request owner and not merged into main.

source_anchors.purpose: Official source index for the 2026/27 IDP/SDBIP and service-level standards documents; listing is not evidence of an integration grant.
Statutory review anchor; legal review triggers are not legal conclusions.
Existing City contact/service channel reference; does not expose or authorize a machine interface.

municipal_sla_source_posture.current_planning_documents_listed: 2026/27 IDP, SDBIP, final IDP and business plans
municipal_sla_source_posture.rule: Do not use a previous-year charter as an adopted current SLA without confirming the current approved source, effective period, clock definitions, denominator and exclusions.

decision.internal_candidate: Commons Support ticket creation/status/assignment may be evaluated as an internal coordination substrate only; it is not designated the canonical municipal service issue.
decision.authoritative_source: The City or utility remains the external authority for its own reference number and current operational status, once the relevant source system and authorised interface are identified.
required_preconditions: Resolve the owner/adaptor census with reviewers and confirm path/build-root authority.
Qualify stable internal issue identity; do not assume the unmerged SUP-CIV-001A branch is active.
Identify the actual City/utility system owner, provider contract, lawful access route and source-currentness semantics.
Bind current approved service-standard source and exact clock/start/stop/reopen rules.
Define data minimisation, protected storage, retention, access/deletion, legal and privacy review.
Qualify idempotent retry/offline behaviour and preserve each original report and its own SLA clock.
Keep completion claim, submitted evidence, independent predicate verification and downstream outcome distinct.
Run synthetic/replay and then shadow evaluation before any restricted operational trial.

invariants: City/utility reference number != Mycelix stable service issue ID.
Local mirror != authoritative current City/utility status.
Municipal acceptance != physical repair or service restoration.
Completion claim != completion evidence != independent verification != outcome improvement.
Deduplication must never erase reports, identities, timestamps or individual service clocks.
Symthaea recommendation != approval, execution capability, civic authority or legal decision.
A signed receipt proves a bounded attestation/provenance statement, not physical truth by itself.
An open branch or queued check != merged code, qualified contract or passed evidence.
